errors.name: SessionAlreadyExists
errors.docs: Session already exists for this owner-delegate pair.

errors.name: SessionNotFound
errors.docs: Session not found.

errors.name: SessionExpired
errors.docs: Session has expired.

errors.name: SessionRevoked
errors.docs: Session has been revoked.

errors.name: SpendingCapExceeded
errors.docs: Total spending cap exceeded.

errors.name: PerTxLimitExceeded
errors.docs: R7-P0-08: Per-transaction limit exceeded.

errors.name: DailyCapExceeded
errors.docs: R7-P0-08: Daily spending cap exceeded.

errors.name: PalletNotAllowed
errors.docs: Pallet not in allowlist.

errors.name: TooManySessions
errors.docs: Too many active sessions for this owner.

errors.name: DurationTooLong
errors.docs: Session duration exceeds maximum.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.docs: Only the owner can manage this session.

errors.name: NotDelegate
errors.docs: Only the delegate can execute via this session.

errors.name: SelfDelegation
errors.docs: Cannot create session for self.

errors.name: CircuitBreakerTripped
errors.docs: R7-P0-08: Circuit breaker tripped — delegate must wait for period reset.

errors.name: SessionRotationLimited
errors.docs: R7-P0-08: Session rotation rate limit exceeded.

errors.name: InvalidSessionNonce
errors.docs:
INV-S01: supplied session nonce does not match the expected value
(stale/replayed authorization).

errors.name: SessionNonceExhausted
errors.docs:
INV-S01: the pair's replay nonce cannot be advanced any further. Fails closed —
wrapping it would make the authorization at the final nonce replayable.

errors.name: RetiredSessionRecordMissing
errors.docs:
The pair held a session whose record is gone while its replay nonce survives —
inherited state from a pre-#3787 expiry cleanup. Re-granting is refused because
the removed record's consumed spend is not recoverable from this state and a
fresh grant would reset it to zero.

errors.name: PalletNameTooLong
errors.docs: An `allowed_pallets` entry is longer than 64 bytes.

errors.name: TooManyAllowedPallets
errors.docs: `allowed_pallets` has more entries than `MaxAllowedPallets`.

errors.name: SpendExceedsDeclared
errors.docs: The dispatched call moved more of the owner's balance than `spend_amount`.

errors.name: RequiredToplocEvidenceMissing
errors.docs:
#753 / D-0431: settlement requires a TOPLOC activation commitment for this
channel's assurance class, but none was submitted (fail closed).

errors.name: ToplocEvidenceChannelNotOpen
errors.docs: #753: `submit_toploc_evidence` requires the channel to be `Open`.

errors.name: ZeroToplocCommitment
errors.docs: #753: a TOPLOC commitment reference must be non-zero.

errors.name: ToplocEscalationOpen
errors.docs:
#754: settlement is frozen — a TOPLOC escalation case is open for this channel
and must reach a terminal verdict (slash / clear / timeout) first.

errors.name: NoToplocEscalation
errors.docs: #754: no open TOPLOC escalation case exists for this channel.

errors.name: ToplocEscalationNotExpired
errors.docs: #754: the escalation window has not elapsed yet; cannot time it out.

errors.name: ChannelExists
errors.docs: A channel with this id already exists.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.docs: No such channel.

errors.name: ZeroEscrow
errors.docs: Escrow must be non-zero.

errors.name: TooManyActiveReservations
errors.docs: Per-identity active reservation cap exceeded (A1 anti-spam; cap scales with escrow not flat).

errors.name: NotAParty
errors.docs: Caller is not a party to this channel.

errors.name: BadState
errors.docs: The channel is not in the required state for this action.

errors.name: MeasuredRootMismatch
errors.docs: The submitted measured root does not match the channel commitment.

errors.name: MeasuredRootRejected
errors.docs: The measured root failed the registry gate (§3.3).

errors.name: BadReceiptSignature
errors.docs: The agent receipt signature did not verify (cooperative settle).

errors.name: AggregateGnMismatch
errors.docs: Agent-signed aggregate `G_n` did not equal the transcript-verified turn sum.

errors.name: DuplicateVerifiedTurn
errors.docs: The same turn was supplied twice in a settlement proof bundle.

errors.name: VerifiedTurnOutOfBounds
errors.docs: A verified turn index exceeds the channel's SLA turn bound.

errors.name: TooManySettlementTurns
errors.docs: A settlement proof bundle carried more turns than `MaxSettlementTurns`.

errors.name: MerklePathTooLong
errors.docs: A verified turn's Merkle authentication path exceeded `MaxMerklePathLen`.

errors.name: SlaMaxTurnsTooLarge
errors.docs: An SLA `max_turns` exceeds `MaxSettlementTurns` (would strand settlement).

errors.name: VerifiedWorkOverflow
errors.docs: The transcript-verified `G_n` sum overflowed `u128`.

errors.name: VerifiedWorkExceedsEscrow
errors.docs: Transcript-verified work exceeds the escrow reservation.

errors.name: TariffExceedsEscrow
errors.docs: Two-part tariff (`BasePerTurn · turns + Σ G_n`) exceeds the escrow reservation.

errors.name: TariffRegression
errors.docs: A settling repost lowered the two-part tariff pay (would underpay the miner).

errors.name: RefundPenaltyOverflow
errors.docs: Refund penalty multiplication overflowed u128.

errors.name: BadEnclaveSignature
errors.docs: The enclave signature over the contested leaf did not verify.

errors.name: UnsupportedLeafVersion
errors.docs: The selected leaf version is not accepted for this channel profile.

errors.name: LeafFieldsInconsistent
errors.docs: Fields unused by the selected version were non-zero, or V3 lacked `h_ids`.

errors.name: LeafNotInRoot
errors.docs: The contested leaf is not a member of the committed transcript root.

errors.name: WindowNotElapsed
errors.docs: The challenge window / response window has not yet elapsed.

errors.name: WindowElapsed
errors.docs: The challenge window, or the open dispute's response window, has already elapsed.

errors.name: DisputeExists
errors.docs: A dispute is already open on this channel.

errors.name: DisputeNotFound
errors.docs: No dispute is open on this channel.

errors.name: WrongTurnResponded
errors.docs: `respond_dispute` proved a different turn than the one the challenger contested.

errors.name: BisectionNotAtLeaf
errors.docs: Multi-round bisection is still narrowing; leaf response not yet legal.

errors.name: BisectionNotAwaitingResponse
errors.docs: Miner already posted child roots (or leaf is isolated); wrong phase.

errors.name: BisectionNotAwaitingChallenge
errors.docs: Challenger already chose (or miner has not opened); wrong phase.

errors.name: BisectionBadChildRoots
errors.docs: Child roots do not hash to the active interval parent root.

errors.name: BisectionBadTurnCount
errors.docs: Bisection turn count must be a power of two in `[2, MaxSettlementTurns]`.

errors.name: BisectionRoundCap
errors.docs: Midpoint rounds exceeded `⌈log₂ MaxSettlementTurns⌉`.

errors.name: SessionNotExpired
errors.docs: The session has not exceeded its max duration (timeout precondition).

errors.name: GnRegression
errors.docs: Aggregate `G_n` regressed below the already-posted claim (replay).

errors.name: TranscriptUnavailable
errors.docs: The disputed transcript is no longer retrievable from DA.

errors.name: TranscriptNotUnrecoverable
errors.docs: Transcript DA is still recoverable; unrecoverable void does not apply.

errors.name: ModelWeightsLeaseExpired
errors.docs:
The model's weights lease has expired (or is inside grace) — top it up
in `da-registry` before opening a session against it (D-0407).

errors.name: NotPendingAck
errors.docs: The channel is not awaiting a `force_ack` (wrong state for this action).

errors.name: AckWindowElapsed
errors.docs:
The `force_open` ack window has already elapsed — the open can now only be
expired ([`Pallet::expire_force_open`]), not acked.

errors.name: AckWindowNotElapsed
errors.docs: The `force_open` ack window has not yet elapsed; the open cannot be expired.

errors.name: NotNamedMiner
errors.docs: Caller is not the named miner for this `force_open`.

errors.name: OfferExpired
errors.docs: The standing offer expired against the finalized head.

errors.name: OfferNotExpired
errors.docs: A funded offer cannot be cancelled until its signed expiry passes.

errors.name: OfferNonceUsed
errors.docs: This miner-scoped offer nonce was already accepted.

errors.name: BadOfferSignature
errors.docs: The standing offer signature did not verify against its miner account.

errors.name: BadOfferAcceptanceSignature
errors.docs: The agent receipt key did not countersign the exact offer acceptance.

errors.name: OfferEscrowBelowMinimum
errors.docs: Submitted escrow is below the offer's signed minimum.

errors.name: FcuNotActivated
errors.docs: FCU parameters are intentionally unset in the runtime.

errors.name: InvalidForwardTerms
errors.docs: Forward window/rate/quota/price/bond terms are malformed.

errors.name: ForwardOfferNotFunded
errors.docs: Forward offer must be funded before countersigned pickup.

errors.name: ForwardOfferFundingMismatch
errors.docs: The signed offer does not match its funded bond commitment.

errors.name: ForwardNotStarted
errors.docs: Forward service evidence cannot be posted before `start_block`.

errors.name: ForwardWindowNotElapsed
errors.docs: Forward position has not reached its terminal window.

errors.name: ForwardDeliveryOutOfBounds
errors.docs: The requested delivery regresses or exceeds the contracted quota.

errors.name: NoForwardAvailabilityAccrued
errors.docs: No new availability earnout has accrued.

errors.name: FcuSlashPaused
errors.docs:
No successful/missed Ghost evidence exists for the elapsed window.
D-0430 degraded state or F2 mass-slash breaker pauses default.

errors.name: TooManyForwardChannels
errors.docs: Bounded miner reverse index is full.

errors.name: ForwardArithmeticOverflow
errors.docs: Checked FCU payment/bond/earnout arithmetic overflowed.

errors.name: ForwardAssignmentLockedPrincipal
errors.docs:
A forward position cannot be funded from vesting-locked principal, and so
cannot change refund owner.

errors.name: ForwardLotTooSmall
errors.docs: Unit transfer would create a non-zero balance below the governed lot.

errors.name: TooManyForwardHolders
errors.docs: Holder cap would be exceeded.

errors.name: ForwardHolderHasActiveDraw
errors.docs: Transfers cannot preempt a holder's live draw.

errors.name: ForwardHolderNotFound
errors.docs: No holder units or terminal pull distribution exist.

errors.name: ForwardDrawUnavailable
errors.docs: Draw rate is zero, exceeds remaining capacity, or draw id is reused.

errors.name: TooManyForwardDraws
errors.docs: Concurrent draw-record cap reached.

errors.name: ForwardBidExists
errors.docs: Bid nonce/object already exists.

errors.name: ForwardBidBadPhase
errors.docs: Bid phase/deadline does not permit this transition.

errors.name: ForwardBidClaimInvalid
errors.docs: Claim commitment missing, duplicated, or incorrectly revealed.

errors.name: ForwardBidClaimantSetInvalid
errors.docs: Claim set is empty or full.

errors.name: ForwardBidEntropyUnavailable
errors.docs: Post-registration entropy was unavailable.

errors.name: FinalitySafeMode
errors.docs: Finality is stalled; new finality-dependent channel opens are disabled.

errors.name: ToplocToleranceNotCalibrated
errors.docs: The model has no governance-calibrated TOPLOC tolerance band (fail closed).

errors.name: ToplocBandUnavailable
errors.docs: Derived TOPLOC band constants are missing or misordered (fail closed).

errors.name: ToplocEvidenceMismatch
errors.docs: The TOPLOC attestation bundle does not all vouch for identical evidence.

errors.name: ToplocEvidenceChannelMismatch
errors.docs: The TOPLOC evidence references a different channel than the one disputed.

errors.name: ToplocVerifierAccepted
errors.docs:
The attested activation is inside the calibrated band (no fraud), or the
committed and recomputed hashes are identical (the verifier accepted).

errors.name: ValidatorNotActive
errors.docs: A TOPLOC attestation signer is not an active validator.

errors.name: InvalidValidatorSignature
errors.docs: A TOPLOC attestation signature did not verify, or its id is malformed.

errors.name: ToplocQuorumNotMet
errors.docs: The distinct active-validator signers did not meet the BFT quorum.

errors.name: NotPremiumChannel
errors.docs: #535: the channel was not opened as `CertificatePremium`.

errors.name: PremiumRequiresInt8Exact
errors.docs: #534: premium class requires INT8-exact serving (W8A8/int32 accumulate).

errors.name: PremiumRequiresWeightCommitment
errors.docs: #533: the model has no registered weight MLE commitment at this precision.

errors.name: PremiumPriceFloorNotMet
errors.docs: #535: escrow does not meet `price_per_gflop · gn · MinCertificatePremiumPpm`.

errors.name: CertificateRejected
errors.docs: #535: the work certificate did not verify (or no verifier backend is wired).

errors.name: BookkeepingRejected
errors.docs:
#794: the supplied bookkeeping cert did not verify — the settled
`aggregate_gn` was not proven to equal `Σ per-leaf g_n` (or no verifier
backend is wired).

errors.name: BookkeepingRequired
errors.docs:
#794: the runtime's `BookkeepingVerifier` requires a bookkeeping cert but
the caller omitted it (`bookkeeping_cert == None`). Fail closed — a miner
cannot skip the aggregation-integrity gate on the certified money path.

errors.name: MeteringRejected
errors.docs:
#871: the supplied metering cert did not verify — a per-leaf `g_n` was
not proven to equal `measured_gn(committed counts)` under the band cap
(or no verifier backend is wired).

errors.name: MeteringRequired
errors.docs:
#871: the runtime's `MeteringCertVerifier` requires a metering cert but
the caller omitted it (`metering_cert == None`). Fail closed — a miner
cannot skip the per-leaf `g_n`-honesty gate on the certified money path.

errors.name: CalibrationUnavailable
errors.docs: No calibration cap was available for a nonzero settlement.

errors.name: SettlementExceedsCalibrationCap
errors.docs: Session settlement exceeded `min(snapshot_cap, current_cap) * elapsed_blocks`.

errors.name: ToplocProfileNotPinned
errors.docs: The channel has no pinned TOPLOC attestation profile for the new claim path.

errors.name: InvalidToplocAttestClaim
errors.docs: The shared attestation claim failed registry/profile/quorum verification.

errors.name: ToplocClaimSubjectMismatch
errors.docs: The shared TOPLOC claim subject did not bind the disputed evidence tuple.

errors.name: InvalidToplocVerdict
errors.docs: TOPLOC mismatch claims only uphold fraud-tagged failed verdicts.

errors.name: AttestationStale
errors.docs: The channel's attestation freshness window elapsed before settlement.

errors.name: DegradedWindowExtensionCapped
errors.docs: The objective degraded-state extension cap is exhausted.

errors.name: DecodePolicyRejected
errors.docs: The decode policy was not allowed for the model at channel open.

errors.name: DecodePolicyHashMismatch
errors.docs: A transcript proof did not match the channel-pinned decode policy.

errors.name: NoDisputeStanding
errors.docs:
Origin lacks dispute standing (D-0424): must be the channel agent or an
active validator. Rejected before the challenger bond is locked.

errors.name: MissingAuditEvidence
errors.docs:
#846: an audit-fee claim requires submitted evidence (a non-zero attestation
commitment). Fail closed — no evidence, no pay (no unpaid-duty path).

errors.name: AuditAlreadyClaimed
errors.docs: #846: this validator has already claimed the audit fee for this channel.

errors.name: AuditPoolInsufficient
errors.docs:
#846: the audit pool has insufficient earmarked funds to pay this claim.
Fail closed — a duty is never assigned that the pool cannot fund.

errors.name: DisputeTurnNotSettled
errors.docs:
The disputed turn was not verified at the current settlement post (or the
channel was settled before posted turns were recorded), so the miner could
not answer it. Rejected before the challenger bond is locked.

errors.name: SettlementTariffMissing
errors.docs:
Terminal unrecoverable-DA settlement requires a posted tariff or an
explicitly eligible legacy tariff materialized after v1 → v2 activation.

errors.name: MinerRetired
errors.docs: New exposure cannot target a permanently retired miner.

errors.name: SessionEvidenceTooLarge
errors.docs: Session DA size is zero, exceeds its typed slot cap, or overflows.

errors.name: SessionEvidenceConflict
errors.docs: An immutable evidence slot was already assigned different bytes.

errors.name: ForwardStateUpgradeRequired
errors.docs: Predecessor forward state must be explicitly handled before exact-rate execution.

errors.name: ForwardListingLocked
errors.docs: Seller has locked outgoing rights behind an outstanding listing.

errors.name: ForwardListingUnavailable
errors.docs: Listing is absent, stale, expired, exhausted, or bound to different rights.

errors.name: ForwardSalePriceExceeded
errors.docs: Exact whole-listing payment exceeds the buyer's signed budget.

errors.name: FcuEconomicSnapshotMissing
errors.docs: Funded obligations require their original economic snapshot.

errors.name: FcuObligationsOutstanding
errors.docs: Clearing configuration would disable outstanding financial claims.

errors.name: FcuPrimaryAdmissionsPaused
errors.docs: New primary funding or position creation is paused by governance.

errors.name: FcuNativeIntegrationRequired
errors.docs: Native service binding and custody must be implemented before new exposure.

errors.name: MinerCapacityFullyReserved
errors.docs: D-0542: the miner's live capacity reservations leave no room for this channel's rate.

errors.name: TooManyCapacityReservations
errors.docs: D-0542: the miner already holds the maximum number of live capacity reservations.

errors.name: ZeroCapacityReservationRate
errors.docs: D-0542: a capacity reservation rate must be positive.

errors.name: UnconsentedSessionTooLong
errors.docs:
D-0542: an open the miner did not sign asked for a window above
`MaxUnconsentedSessionBlocks`.

errors.name: EscrowBelowCapacityFloor
errors.docs:
D-0542: an open the miner did not sign escrowed less than its capacity floor
(reserved rate x window x `UnconsentedReservationTariff`).
